title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-12 SGA repair018 French diagram repair pass
description:
Public SGA working-translation record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record keeps the current reader-facing PDFs, source-scan witnesses, and compact source ZIPs for SGA translation/reconstruction work.

Status at a glance. This is a substantial working-draft and repair record, not a globally certified complete edition or critical edition. SGA repair018 adds a concrete French SGA5 diagram repair pass using the 179-row diagram micropass aid, closing source-level diagram defects on SGA5 source pp.030, 031, and 084. SGA6 French is carried forward from the earlier Expose VI repair lane in this package; the earlier Expose VI repair lane restored source pp.391-397 in French. SGA5 English remains an unsynchronized carry-forward branch. The SGA6 v3 worklist still has open rows, and SGA5/SGA6/SGA7 may still contain subtle or visible errors outside patched lanes, including diagram-arrow direction, missing-arrow, exact-symbol, and synchronization problems. SGA7-I should be read as working draft material with explicit compression/source-checking caveats unless a specific packet declares a source-checked range.

Filename warning. Older filenames containing words such as Complete, Strict, or Source-Checked are legacy package names and are not current global certification claims. Source-witness and aid ZIPs are locator/check layers, not textual authority by themselves.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Current public status follows the 2026-06-12 repair018 summary: SGA5 French closes concrete diagram defects on source pp.030, 031, and 084 using the 179-row diagram aid. SGA6 French is carried forward from the earlier Expose VI repair lane, and SGA5 English remains unsynchronized. This is not a certified critical edition; legacy file names that say Complete or Source-Checked should be overridden by this status note.
